sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集最初作为付费订阅者的早期福利，发布在Casefile的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道上。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集篇幅稍短，旨在让我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 如需抢先收听且无广告的剧集，您可以在您偏好的平台上支持Casefile。

sentences.en: In the 1990s, Trice Konyeva, his wife Jacquelinea, and their two young children fled their homeland of Macedonia to escape the war-torn Balkans.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代，特里斯·科涅瓦（Trice Konyeva）与妻子杰奎琳娜（Jacquelinea）以及两个年幼的孩子，为了逃离战火纷飞的巴尔干半岛，离开了家乡马其顿。

sentences.en: The Konyevas were granted political asylum in England, and by 1997, they were happily settled in their new home.
sentences.zh: 科涅瓦一家在英国获得了政治庇护，到1997年，他们已在新的家园安顿下来，生活幸福。

sentences.en: They lived in a cosy Victorian-era terrace in the West London district of Hammersmith.
sentences.zh: 他们住在伦敦西部哈默史密斯区一栋舒适的维多利亚时代联排别墅里。

sentences.en: The home was small, but it allowed the Konyevas to reside in the city.
sentences.zh: 房子虽小，却让他们得以在城里安家落户。

sentences.en: A living area towards the front of the house doubled as a shared bedroom for the children.
sentences.zh: 房子前部的起居区同时也是孩子们的共享卧室。

sentences.en: Thursday May 22 was set to be a busy day for the family.
sentences.zh: 5月22日星期四，对这家人来说注定是忙碌的一天。

sentences.en: Trice worked as a web designer and was also studying English at Hammersmith College as a mature age student.
sentences.zh: 特里斯是一名网页设计师，同时也是哈默史密斯学院的一名大龄学生，正在学习英语。

sentences.en: Jacquelinea, who typically spent her days at home, had made special plans to visit a friend.
sentences.zh: 通常白天待在家里的杰奎琳娜，那天特意计划去拜访一位朋友。

sentences.en: The couple's two children, 12-year-old Katerina and a 6-year-old Christian, were off to school.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的两个孩子，12岁的卡特琳娜（Katerina）和6岁的克里斯蒂安（Christian），都去上学了。

sentences.en: Trice exchanged smiles with his daughter as she boarded the school bus.
sentences.zh: 特里斯在女儿登上校车时，与她相视一笑。

sentences.en: Katerina wore her blue and grey school uniform with her long, dark hair down.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜穿着蓝灰色的校服，留着一头长长的深色直发。

sentences.en: She carried her books in a red and white tote bag stamped with the Virgin Airlines logo.
sentences.zh: 她用一个印有维珍航空标志的红白相间手提袋装着书本。

sentences.en: The bag had been a gift upon her arrival in England.
sentences.zh: 那个包是她刚到英国时收到的礼物。

sentences.en: Back then, it held the few prized possessions she could carry from Macedonia, some photographs, a colouring book, and a teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 那时，包里装着她从马其顿带出来的几件珍贵物品：一些照片、一本涂色书和一个泰迪熊。

sentences.en: After bidding his daughter farewell, Trice mounted his bicycle and headed to college.
sentences.zh: 送别女儿后，特里斯骑上自行车前往学院。

sentences.en: He had an English exam that afternoon and a teacher wished to speak to him afterwards.
sentences.zh: 那天下午他有一场英语考试，考完后老师还想找他谈话。

sentences.en: This meant Katerina would arrive home from school to an empty house, which made Trice anxious.
sentences.zh: 这意味着卡特琳娜放学回家时家里会空无一人，这让特里斯感到焦虑。

sentences.en: He had never left his daughter home alone before, but he reassured himself that everything would be alright.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未让女儿独自在家，但他安慰自己一切都会没事的。

sentences.en: The exam took longer to complete than expected.
sentences.zh: 考试完成的时间比预期的要长。

sentences.en: As soon as it was over, Trice called home to check in with Katerina.
sentences.zh: 考试一结束，特里斯就打电话回家想确认卡特琳娜的情况。

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 电话无人接听。

sentences.en: Worried, Trice raced home.
sentences.zh: 心急如焚的特里斯飞奔回家。

sentences.en: It was approaching 4.30pm when he reached his front door.
sentences.zh: 他赶到家门口时，时间已接近下午4点30分。

sentences.en: Trice set his bicycle aside and headed in.
sentences.zh: 特里斯放下自行车，冲进屋内。

sentences.en: He approached the living space-turned-children's bedroom, only to find its door wedged shut.
sentences.zh: 他走向那个兼作儿童卧室的起居空间，却发现门被死死抵住了。

sentences.en: Thinking his daughter must have secured it for privacy, Trice knocked and said,
sentences.zh: 特里斯以为是女儿为了隐私锁上了门，于是敲了敲门说道：

sentences.en: It's Daddy.
sentences.zh: 是爸爸。

sentences.en: Open up.
sentences.zh: 开门。

sentences.en: He was met with silence.
sentences.zh: 回应他的是一片寂静。

sentences.en: Trice banged louder and shouted,
sentences.zh: 特里斯用力敲门并大喊：

sentences.en: Katerina!
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜！

sentences.en: Katerina!
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜！

sentences.en: Open the door!
sentences.zh: 把门打开！

sentences.en: He could hear strange noises coming from inside the room.
sentences.zh: 他能听到房间里传来奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: He thrust his shoulder into the door to force it open, but it didn't budge.
sentences.zh: 他用肩膀撞门试图撞开，但门纹丝不动。

sentences.en: Someone had barricaded it from the other side.
sentences.zh: 有人在里面把门堵住了。

sentences.en: Peering through the keyhole, Trice saw Katerina's school bag and uniform.
sentences.zh: 特里斯透过钥匙孔往里看，看到了卡特琳娜的书包和校服。

sentences.en: He knelt down to peer under the door.
sentences.zh: 他跪下来往门底缝隙看去。

sentences.en: A sense of dread washed over Trice.
sentences.zh: 一种恐惧感涌上特里斯的心头。

sentences.en: Inside the room was a pair of men's black boots.
sentences.zh: 房间里有一双男人的黑色靴子。

sentences.en: Trice Koneva was frantic.
sentences.zh: 特里斯·科涅瓦彻底慌了。

sentences.en: He believed he had just interrupted a burglar and assumed the man would make a break for the window.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己撞见了一个窃贼，并推测对方会从窗户逃跑。

sentences.en: Trice ran back outside and came face to face with the intruder just as he rose from his knees at the base of the living room window.
sentences.zh: 特里斯跑回屋外，正好撞见那个入侵者从起居室窗户下方的地面上站起来。

sentences.en: He was clutching a small bag.
sentences.zh: 他手里紧紧抓着一个小包。

sentences.en: There was a small bloody cup just below his left eye and numerous other scratches across his face.
sentences.zh: 他的左眼下方有一道细小的血口，脸上还有多处抓痕。

sentences.en: The two men stared at each other before Trice finally broke the silence.
sentences.zh: 两人对视片刻，特里斯终于打破了沉默。

sentences.en: What are you doing in my house?
sentences.zh: 你在我家干什么？

sentences.en: The stranger didn't reply.
sentences.zh: 陌生人没有回答。

sentences.en: He appeared unnervingly calm.
sentences.zh: 他看起来镇定得令人不安。

sentences.en: Trice moved in and grabbed the man by the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 特里斯冲上去抓住那个男人的肩膀。

sentences.en: In turn, the man produced a small pocket knife.
sentences.zh: 那人随即掏出一把折叠小刀。

sentences.en: As he scrambled to open it, Trice loosened his grip and turned away to protect himself.
sentences.zh: 当他手忙脚乱地打开刀子时，特里斯松开手转身躲避。

sentences.en: The intruder quickly took off running down the street.
sentences.zh: 入侵者迅速逃向街头。

sentences.en: Trice sprinted after him.
sentences.zh: 特里斯紧追不舍。

sentences.en: The pair ran through several streets before Trice caught up to the intruder at a building site.
sentences.zh: 两人穿过几条街道，特里斯终于在一个建筑工地追上了入侵者。

sentences.en: Trice grabbed him in a bear hug.
sentences.zh: 特里斯从背后紧紧抱住他。

sentences.en: The man began calling for help, telling onlookers that Trice was assaulting him.
sentences.zh: 那人开始呼救，告诉围观者特里斯在袭击他。

sentences.en: He had a distinct accent which was difficult to identify.
sentences.zh: 他带着一种难以辨认的独特口音。

sentences.en: Two workmen noticed the scuffle and interceded, shouting at Trice to leave the man alone.
sentences.zh: 两名工人注意到这场扭打并上前干预，大声叫特里斯放开那个人。

sentences.en: Their interruption allowed the intruder to get away, but Trice wasn't about to give up.
sentences.zh: 他们的介入让入侵者得以逃脱，但特里斯并不打算放弃。

sentences.en: He followed the man as he ran out onto the road into peak hour traffic.
sentences.zh: 他跟着那人跑到了车水马龙的公路上。

sentences.en: A woman driving a Datsun had to slam on her brakes to avoid hitting the pair.
sentences.zh: 一名开着达特桑汽车的女子不得不猛踩刹车，才避免撞上两人。

sentences.en: The knife-wielding man attempted to enter the Datsun through an open window.
sentences.zh: 那个持刀男子试图通过敞开的车窗钻进达特桑车内。

sentences.en: The frightened driver had her four-year-old son in the car and swiftly rolled up her window before driving away.
sentences.zh: 受惊的女司机车里还坐着她四岁的儿子，她迅速摇上车窗，开车逃离。

sentences.en: The man then scrambled into the back of a passing lorry before its driver slammed the horn and ordered him to get out.
sentences.zh: 那人随后爬上一辆路过的卡车后部，但司机猛按喇叭并命令他滚下去。

sentences.en: The man then jumped in front of a Fiat Uno, crying out,
sentences.zh: 那人随后跳到一辆菲亚特Uno车前，大喊道：

sentences.en: help me, help me, call the police, before opening the driver's door and forcing the woman behind the wheel out by knife point.
sentences.zh: 救命，救命，报警，随后打开驾驶座车门，用刀逼迫女司机下车。

sentences.en: She managed to push him to the ground, but he quickly leapt into her car and sped off.
sentences.zh: 她设法将他推倒在地，但他迅速跳进她的车里疾驰而去。

sentences.en: A confused and unsettled crowd of witnesses gathered around.
sentences.zh: 一群困惑不安的目击者聚集在周围。

sentences.en: Trice Koneva didn't know the English words to articulate what had just happened.
sentences.zh: 特里斯·科涅瓦不知道该用什么英语词汇来表达刚才发生的一切。

sentences.en: Instead of trying to explain the situation, he sprinted back home.
sentences.zh: 他没有试图解释情况，而是飞奔回家。

sentences.en: By the time he got there, it was 4.50pm.
sentences.zh: 等他赶到家时，已经是下午4点50分了。

sentences.en: Trice ran straight for the living room door and kicked it open.
sentences.zh: 特里斯径直冲向起居室的门，一脚将其踹开。

sentences.en: A chair that had been jammed up against it fell away.
sentences.zh: 抵在门后的一把椅子滑开了。

sentences.en: Katerina lay face up on the floor, unconscious.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜仰面躺在地板上，不省人事。

sentences.en: The strap of her school bag had been cut and was wrapped around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她的书包带子被割断，缠绕在脖子上。

sentences.en: The ligature was so tight that Trice couldn't remove it with his hands.
sentences.zh: 勒痕太紧，特里斯用手根本解不开。

sentences.en: He grabbed a knife from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他从厨房拿来一把刀。

sentences.en: Katerina's face was purple and she was barely clinging to life.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜的脸已经发紫，生命垂危。

sentences.en: Trice cradled his daughter's body, repeating her name through tears, while shouting,
sentences.zh: 特里斯抱着女儿的身体，泪流满面地呼唤着她的名字，同时大喊：

sentences.en: Please come and help me, someone.
sentences.zh: 求求你们，来帮帮我，救命啊。

sentences.en: A neighbour overheard Trice's cries and contacted emergency services.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居听到了特里斯的呼救声，联系了急救部门。

sentences.en: Soon, the Koneva's living room was abuzz with police and paramedics.
sentences.zh: 很快，科涅瓦家的起居室里挤满了警察和医护人员。

sentences.en: They tried to resuscitate Katerina, but their efforts were in vain.
sentences.zh: 他们试图抢救卡特琳娜，但一切努力都无济于事。

sentences.en: Trice was taken to the police station for questioning, where he was made to wear a white forensic suit.
sentences.zh: 特里斯被带到警察局接受审讯，并被要求穿上白色的法医鉴定服。

sentences.en: Despite telling the police about the knife-wielding intruder, Trice knew they suspected he'd killed his daughter.
sentences.zh: 尽管特里斯向警方讲述了持刀入侵者的事，但他知道他们怀疑是他杀害了自己的女儿。

sentences.en: When his wife, Jacqueline, arrived at the station with their six-year-old son, Christian, she launched at him in a rage, shouting,
sentences.zh: 当他的妻子杰奎琳带着六岁的儿子克里斯蒂安赶到警局时，她愤怒地冲向他，大喊道：

sentences.en: What have you done to our little girl?
sentences.zh: 你对我们的女儿做了什么？

sentences.en: As she kicked and screamed, Christian stared at his father with hatred in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 当她又踢又叫时，克里斯蒂安用充满仇恨的眼神盯着他的父亲。

sentences.en: As the homicide investigation commenced, Trice was left in a cell.
sentences.zh: 随着凶杀案调查的展开，特里斯被关进了牢房。

sentences.en: He couldn't believe what was happening.
sentences.zh: 他无法相信这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: Everyone thought he'd murdered his child, even his own family.
sentences.zh: 每个人都认为他杀了自己的孩子，甚至连他的家人也是如此。

sentences.en: He started banging his head against the cell walls in distress.
sentences.zh: 他痛苦地用头撞击牢房的墙壁。

sentences.en: But when news of Katerina's murder spread, more than 20 eyewitnesses came forward to say they had seen Trice's altercation with an unidentified man.
sentences.zh: 但随着卡特琳娜遇害的消息传开，20多名目击者站出来表示，他们看到了特里斯与一名身份不明男子的争执。

sentences.en: The man was described as Eastern European in appearance, between the ages of 40 and 50, and around 5 foot 3 inches tall.
sentences.zh: 据描述，该男子外貌像东欧人，年龄在40到50岁之间，身高约5英尺3英寸（约1.6米）。

sentences.en: He had a stocky physique, pale complexion, and balding dark hair that was greying at the sides.
sentences.zh: 他身材魁梧，面色苍白，头发稀疏，鬓角发白。

sentences.en: He was wearing black shoes, dark trousers, and a light grey suit or sports jacket, with a white collared shirt underneath.
sentences.zh: 他穿着黑色鞋子、深色长裤和浅灰色西装或运动夹克，里面穿着白色领衬衫。

sentences.en: CCTV footage from the building site where the fight took place also confirmed Trice's version of events.
sentences.zh: 发生打斗的建筑工地的监控录像也证实了特里斯的说法。

sentences.en: It was blurry and filmed from a distance, but sure enough, a man was captured running past, with a second man in pursuit.
sentences.zh: 画面模糊且是从远处拍摄的，但确实拍到了一个男人跑过，后面有第二个男人在追赶。

sentences.en: An examination of the window in the Koneva's living room also revealed foreign fingerprints on the glass and frame.
sentences.zh: 对科涅瓦家起居室窗户的检查也发现了玻璃和窗框上有外人的指纹。

sentences.en: Trice was promptly ruled out as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 特里斯很快被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: He fronted a press conference where he described his daughter as a gifted high achiever.
sentences.zh: 他在新闻发布会上描述女儿是一个天赋异禀、成绩优异的孩子。

sentences.en: Katerina enjoyed school so much she had never taken time off sick.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜非常喜欢学校，从未因病请过假。

sentences.en: She'd excelled in all her subjects, despite only recently learning English, and received 50 commendations for her work.
sentences.zh: 尽管她最近才开始学习英语，但她在所有科目上都表现出色，并获得了50次工作表彰。

sentences.en: She was also the leader of the school's junior choir.
sentences.zh: 她还是学校少年合唱团的团长。

sentences.en: Katerina had fully embraced her new life in England and was a big fan of British pop group the Spice Girls.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜完全融入了她在英国的新生活，还是英国流行组合“辣妹合唱团”的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: Trice Koneva said,
sentences.zh: 特里斯·科涅瓦说：

sentences.en: All Katerina's friends loved her.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜所有的朋友都爱她。

sentences.en: For her, the world was there to love.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，这个世界是值得去爱的。

sentences.en: Speaking of his daughter's killer, Trice remarked,
sentences.zh: 谈到杀害女儿的凶手，特里斯评论道：

sentences.en: This is not a man, it's a monster without feelings.
sentences.zh: 这不是人，这是一个没有感情的怪物。

sentences.en: Animals don't kill like that.
sentences.zh: 动物都不会那样杀人。

sentences.en: We don't know how many more children he could kill.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他还会杀害多少孩子。

sentences.en: Detectives theorised that Katerina's killer followed her as she walked home after school.
sentences.zh: 侦探们推测，卡特琳娜的凶手在她放学回家的路上跟踪了她。

sentences.en: He soon realised she was home alone.
sentences.zh: 他很快意识到她独自在家。

sentences.en: As there were no signs of a break-in, he either entered an unlocked front door or Katerina opened it to him.
sentences.zh: 由于没有破门而入的迹象，他要么是从未锁的前门进入，要么是卡特琳娜为他开了门。

sentences.en: She must have been incapacitated quickly, as there were no reports of anyone having heard a scuffle, cries, or yelling.
sentences.zh: 她一定很快就失去了反抗能力，因为没有报告称有人听到过打斗、哭喊或叫声。

sentences.en: Post-mortem results concluded that Katerina had first been throttled by hand, then strangled with the ligature.
sentences.zh: 尸检结果显示，卡特琳娜先是被徒手掐住，随后被绳索勒死。

sentences.en: The car the killer had stolen was found abandoned a quarter of a mile away from the building site.
sentences.zh: 凶手偷走的那辆车在距离建筑工地四分之一英里外被发现，已被遗弃。

sentences.en: He'd seemingly dumped it after struggling to navigate London's busy afternoon traffic.
sentences.zh: 他似乎在难以应对伦敦繁忙的午后交通后，就把车丢弃了。

sentences.en: Investigators tracked the killer's trail from there.
sentences.zh: 调查人员从那里追踪了凶手的踪迹。

sentences.en: He had headed on foot to Hammersmith bus station.
sentences.zh: 他步行前往哈默史密斯汽车站。

sentences.en: At around 4.50pm, he boarded the number 220 bus.
sentences.zh: 下午4点50分左右，他登上了一辆220路公交车。

sentences.en: The driver had noticed that his face was spattered with blood.
sentences.zh: 司机注意到他的脸上溅满了血迹。

sentences.en: At 5pm, the bus arrived at Hammersmith Broadway, a major transport node, and the killer disembarked.
sentences.zh: 下午5点，公交车抵达主要交通枢纽哈默史密斯百老汇，凶手下了车。

sentences.en: From there, the trail went cold.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，线索断了。

sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.en: Soon, police discovered links between Katerina Konyaeva's murder and other attacks that had taken place in Hammersmith.
sentences.zh: 不久，警方发现了卡特琳娜·科涅瓦谋杀案与哈默史密斯地区发生的其他袭击事件之间的联系。

sentences.en: Months earlier, in February, a girl was followed home from school by a man matching the description of Katerina's killer.
sentences.zh: 几个月前的二月，一名女孩在放学回家时被一名外貌特征与卡特琳娜凶手相符的男子跟踪。

sentences.en: After the girl ran inside her home, the man tried to open the front door.
sentences.zh: 女孩跑进家门后，那名男子试图打开前门。

sentences.en: He scratched at the lock and rang the doorbell, but the girl stayed away.
sentences.zh: 他在锁上抓挠并按了门铃，但女孩没有理会。

sentences.en: Eventually, the man fled.
sentences.zh: 最终，该男子逃走了。

sentences.en: Another incident had occurred just 30 minutes before Katerina was attacked.
sentences.zh: 在卡特琳娜遇袭前30分钟，还发生了另一起事件。

sentences.en: A few streets from where the Konyaeva's lived, a man matching the killer's description tailed another 12-year-old girl to her home.
sentences.zh: 在距离科涅瓦家几条街的地方，一名外貌与凶手相符的男子跟踪了另一名12岁女孩回家。

sentences.en: He watched the property for several minutes before leaving.
sentences.zh: 他在观察了该房产几分钟后离开。

sentences.en: All the girls targeted had dark hair and were wearing school uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 所有被盯上的女孩都留着深色头发，穿着校服。

sentences.en: Criminal profilers were convinced that it was only a matter of time before the Hammersmith predator struck again.
sentences.zh: 犯罪侧写师确信，哈默史密斯的这个掠食者再次作案只是时间问题。

sentences.en: Yet, his crimes suddenly dropped from the headlines two months later when Diana, Princess of Wales, was killed in a car crash in Paris.
sentences.zh: 然而，两个月后，威尔士王妃戴安娜在巴黎死于车祸，他的罪行瞬间从头条新闻中消失了。

sentences.en: Her death led to extensive public mourning and received global media attention.
sentences.zh: 她的离世引发了大规模的公众哀悼，并受到了全球媒体的关注。

sentences.en: Despite the reduced public interest, investigators were certain they could solve Katerina Konyaeva's murder quickly.
sentences.zh: 尽管公众兴趣减退，调查人员仍确信他们能迅速破获卡特琳娜·科尼亚耶娃的谋杀案。

sentences.en: A televised appeal and reconstruction of the crime led to more than 200 tip-offs.
sentences.zh: 电视上的呼吁和案情重演带来了超过200条线索。

sentences.en: Detectives had witnesses, CCTV footage, a suspect description, and the killer's fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 侦探们掌握了证人、监控录像、嫌疑人描述以及凶手的指纹。

sentences.en: They'd also recovered his DNA from the ligature used on Katerina.
sentences.zh: 他们还在勒死卡特琳娜的绳索上提取到了他的DNA。

sentences.en: He'd also left a strand of his hair on her cardigan.
sentences.zh: 他还把一根头发留在了她的开衫上。

sentences.en: Yet, it soon became clear that the case wasn't as open and shut as investigators first thought.
sentences.zh: 然而，很快人们就发现，这起案件并不像调查人员最初认为的那样简单明了。

sentences.en: Despite having a detailed composite sketch of the killer, he wasn't identified.
sentences.zh: 尽管有凶手的详细模拟画像，但他仍未被确认身份。

sentences.en: Nor did his fingerprints or DNA profile match anyone in the police database.
sentences.zh: 他的指纹和DNA档案也与警方数据库中的任何人都不匹配。

sentences.en: Both were sent through to Interpol, the international criminal police organisation that facilitates worldwide police cooperation and crime control.
sentences.zh: 这两项信息都被送往国际刑警组织，这是一个促进全球警务合作和打击犯罪的国际刑事警察机构。

sentences.en: Through Interpol, the unidentified killer's details were shared with over 120 countries.
sentences.zh: 通过国际刑警组织，这名身份不明的凶手的详细信息被分享到了120多个国家。

sentences.en: But nothing was uncovered.
sentences.zh: 但一无所获。

sentences.en: British authorities reached out to law enforcement agencies in 26 countries to see if they had any similar attacks or suspects.
sentences.zh: 英国当局联系了26个国家的执法机构，查看他们是否有类似的袭击事件或嫌疑人。

sentences.en: This inquiry led nowhere.
sentences.zh: 这项调查毫无进展。

sentences.en: A list of 600 suspects was whittled down to 100.
sentences.zh: 600名嫌疑人的名单被缩减到了100人。

sentences.en: Many possibilities were explored, including that the killer had known the Koneeva family in Macedonia.
sentences.zh: 许多可能性都被探讨过，包括凶手在马其顿就认识科尼亚耶娃一家。

sentences.en: But months turned into years, with no breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 但时光流逝，数月转眼变数年，依然没有突破。

sentences.en: A £20,000 reward was offered.
sentences.zh: 警方悬赏2万英镑征集线索。

sentences.en: Trice Koneeva made an emotional plea for help, saying,
sentences.zh: 特里斯·科尼亚耶娃含泪发出求助，说道：

sentences.en: In mid to late 2002, a 21-year-old Korean student, Ari, not her real name, moved to London.
sentences.zh: 2002年中后期，一名21岁的韩国留学生阿里（化名）搬到了伦敦。

sentences.en: By Sunday, September 22, she had only been in the city for three weeks.
sentences.zh: 到9月22日星期日那天，她来这座城市才不过三周。

sentences.en: That day, Ari was waiting for a friend at the Ealing Broadway Transit Station.
sentences.zh: 那天，阿里正在伊灵百老汇交通枢纽站等朋友。

sentences.en: As she was in search of cheap accommodation, she passed the time by looking at adverts for local bedsits that were posted in the window of a news agency.
sentences.zh: 由于她在寻找廉价住所，便在一家报刊亭的窗户上查看张贴的当地出租房广告来打发时间。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, a man approached her.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个男人向她走来。

sentences.en: He was in his mid-forties, short and stocky.
sentences.zh: 他四十多岁，身材矮壮。

sentences.en: A wig covered his balding head and he spoke broken English in an Eastern European accent.
sentences.zh: 他戴着假发遮住秃顶，说着带有东欧口音的蹩脚英语。

sentences.en: Ari couldn't fully grasp what the man was saying, as her English was also limited, but he managed to get his point across.
sentences.zh: 阿里无法完全听懂他在说什么，因为她的英语水平也有限，但他还是成功表达了自己的意思。

sentences.en: He had noticed her looking for housing and wanted to offer her a vacant room at his communal flat in the nearby suburb of Acton.
sentences.zh: 他注意到她在找房子，想向她提供他在附近阿克顿郊区合租公寓里的一间空房。

sentences.en: Ari agreed to follow the man to his ground floor home.
sentences.zh: 阿里同意跟随这名男子去他位于一楼的住所。

sentences.en: It was grubby and sparsely furnished.
sentences.zh: 那里又脏又乱，家具稀少。

sentences.en: Unimpressed, Ari told the man she was leaving to meet her friend.
sentences.zh: 阿里对环境很不满意，告诉男人她要离开去见朋友。

sentences.en: He told her to relax while moving towards the front door to lock it.
sentences.zh: 他让她放松点，同时走向前门把门锁上了。

sentences.en: Then, without warning, he pushed Ari onto his bed and began strangling her.
sentences.zh: 接着，毫无预兆地，他把阿里推到床上并开始掐她的脖子。

sentences.en: Ari managed to grab a ballpoint pen and tried to use it to fight back, but she was overpowered.
sentences.zh: 阿里设法抓起一支圆珠笔试图反抗，但还是被制服了。

sentences.en: Soon, she was on the cusp of losing consciousness.
sentences.zh: 很快，她就处于失去意识的边缘。

sentences.en: When Ari came to, her hands were tied together with rope and her mouth was gagged.
sentences.zh: 当阿里醒来时，她的双手被绳子绑在一起，嘴也被堵住了。

sentences.en: The man raped Ari for three hours.
sentences.zh: 那名男子强奸了阿里三个小时。

sentences.en: When she promised to contact him the next day, he finally let Ari go.
sentences.zh: 当她答应第二天联系他时，他终于放阿里走了。

sentences.en: She promptly reported her ordeal to the police, who quickly identified Ari's attacker.
sentences.zh: 她立即向警方报告了这段痛苦的经历，警方很快就锁定了阿里的袭击者。

sentences.en: His passport and other documentation listed him as a 45-year-old Portuguese national named José Marco de Diaz.
sentences.zh: 他的护照和其他证件显示，他是一名45岁的葡萄牙公民，名叫何塞·马尔科·德·迪亚兹。

sentences.en: He was charged with three rapes, two counts of indecent assault, false imprisonment, and attempting to choke.
sentences.zh: 他被控三项强奸罪、两项猥亵罪、非法监禁罪以及企图窒息罪。

sentences.en: At trial in May the following year, Ari's attacker asserted that she had consented to sex as a thank you for helping her find somewhere to stay.
sentences.zh: 在次年五月的审判中，阿里的袭击者声称，她是出于感谢他帮她找到住处才同意发生性关系的。

sentences.en: The jury wasn't convinced, and the judge sentenced him to nine years.
sentences.zh: 陪审团并不相信，法官判处他九年监禁。

sentences.en: With the rapist convicted, police uploaded his DNA and fingerprints into their database to see if he was tied to any other crimes.
sentences.zh: 强奸犯被定罪后，警方将他的DNA和指纹上传到数据库，以查看他是否与其他犯罪有关联。

sentences.en: There was a match.
sentences.zh: 结果匹配上了。

sentences.en: Andrzej Klembert was born in March 1956 in Warsaw, Poland.
sentences.zh: 安杰伊·克伦伯特于1956年3月出生在波兰华沙。

sentences.en: At age two, he was placed in an orphanage as his father, mother, and maternal grandmother were all in prison for theft, burglary, and fraud, respectively.
sentences.zh: 两岁时，他被送进了孤儿院，因为他的父亲、母亲和外祖母分别因盗窃、入室行窃和欺诈罪入狱。

sentences.en: His grandfather was in a state psychiatric hospital for unspecified sexual offences.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父因未指明的性犯罪被关在国立精神病院。

sentences.en: When Andrzej Klembert's mother was released, she regained custody of her son.
sentences.zh: 安杰伊·克伦伯特的母亲获释后，重新获得了儿子的监护权。

sentences.en: She divorced her husband and married a cement mason.
sentences.zh: 她与丈夫离婚，嫁给了一名水泥泥瓦匠。

sentences.en: Andrzej took his stepfather's surname, Kunowski.
sentences.zh: 安杰伊改随继父的姓氏，库诺夫斯基。

sentences.en: He was raised in the town of Muawa in the Polish lowlands, 80 miles north of Warsaw.
sentences.zh: 他在华沙以北80英里的波兰低地城镇姆瓦瓦长大。

sentences.en: As a child, Kunowski was described as nervous and introverted.
sentences.zh: 童年时期的库诺夫斯基被描述为神经质且内向。

sentences.en: He was teased at school for being a mama's boy and lashed out at the smallest provocation.
sentences.zh: 他在学校里因为是“妈宝男”而受到嘲笑，并会因一点小事就大发雷霆。

sentences.en: During fights, he tried to choke his opponents.
sentences.zh: 在打架时，他总是试图掐住对手的脖子。

sentences.en: Over time, he developed a fixation with girls and would stare at them as though in a trance.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他开始迷恋女孩，盯着她们看时仿佛进入了恍惚状态。

sentences.en: As he entered his teens, Kunowski became a heavy drinker.
sentences.zh: 进入青春期后，库诺夫斯基开始酗酒。

sentences.en: He was prone to violent blackouts and often skipped school.
sentences.zh: 他容易在醉酒后出现暴力行为，而且经常逃学。

sentences.en: When he did attend, he'd grope other students, both male and female.
sentences.zh: 当他去学校时，他会猥亵其他男女学生。

sentences.en: After Kunowski was caught robbing a woman at age 13, he was sent to a facility for delinquent juveniles.
sentences.zh: 13岁时，库诺夫斯基因抢劫一名妇女被抓，随后被送往少年管教所。

sentences.en: His six-month stay there did little to curb his issues.
sentences.zh: 他在那里待了六个月，但几乎没能改掉他的问题。

sentences.en: In 1973, just after he turned 17, Kunowski dragged a 16-year-old neighbour into the bushes and raped her.
sentences.zh: 1973年，刚满17岁的库诺夫斯基将一名16岁的邻居拖进灌木丛并强奸了她。

sentences.en: Two other victims also came forward at this time accusing Kunowski of similar assaults, though he was only charged with the initial one.
sentences.zh: 当时还有另外两名受害者站出来指控库诺夫斯基有类似的袭击行为，但他最终只因第一起案件被起诉。

sentences.en: Believing he had a good chance of being rehabilitated, the court only sentenced him to three years in prison.
sentences.zh: 法院认为他有很好的改造机会，仅判处他三年监禁。

sentences.en: One month after his parole, Kunowski struck again.
sentences.zh: 假释一个月后，库诺夫斯基再次作案。

sentences.en: He grabbed a teenager from behind as she walked alone.
sentences.zh: 他从背后抓住了一名独自走路的少女。

sentences.en: He bound her hands and feet, raped her, and choked her until she lost consciousness.
sentences.zh: 他捆绑了她的手脚，强奸了她，并掐住她的脖子直到她失去知觉。

sentences.en: The girl was saved when passers-by intervened.
sentences.zh: 路人及时干预，女孩才得以获救。

sentences.en: This time, Kunowski was sentenced to two years, but was free again within nine months.
sentences.zh: 这一次，库诺夫斯基被判处两年监禁，但不到九个月就又重获自由。

sentences.en: Upon his release, he began travelling between his hometown and the city of Warsaw on the lookout for lone girls and young women.
sentences.zh: 获释后，他开始在家乡和华沙市之间往返，寻找落单的女孩和年轻女性。

sentences.en: When he spotted one, he would exit his vehicle, grab his victim, then drag her someplace hidden to rape her.
sentences.zh: 一旦发现目标，他就会下车抓住受害者，然后把她拖到隐蔽的地方进行强奸。

sentences.en: His attacks were described as compulsive clusters.
sentences.zh: 他的袭击行为被描述为强迫性的集群式犯罪。

sentences.en: He would go extended periods without offending, then strike on multiple occasions in a small window of time.
sentences.zh: 他会长时间不作案，然后在短时间内连续多次袭击。

sentences.en: Kunowski's crimes always involved a stalking element.
sentences.zh: 库诺夫斯基的犯罪总是包含跟踪的成分。

sentences.en: He relied on his strength as he was incapable of luring in victims with charm.
sentences.zh: 由于无法用魅力诱骗受害者，他只能依靠蛮力。

sentences.en: Most of his attacks involved choking and strangulation, and he often wielded a knife.
sentences.zh: 他的袭击大多涉及掐脖和勒颈，而且他经常携带一把刀。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Kunowski pulled over to ask a woman for directions.
sentences.zh: 有一次，库诺夫斯基靠边停车，向一名女子问路。

sentences.en: When she leant into his car to provide the information,
sentences.zh: 当她探身进车内提供信息时，

sentences.en: Kunowski closed the window on the woman's neck.
sentences.zh: 库诺夫斯基关上车窗，卡住了女子的脖子。

sentences.en: He then proceeded to rape her while she was trapped.
sentences.zh: 随后，他趁她被困住时实施了强奸。

sentences.en: In 1978 alone, Kunowski committed 21 rapes.
sentences.zh: 仅在1978年，库诺夫斯基就犯下了21起强奸案。

sentences.en: His youngest victim was 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 他最年幼的受害者年仅11岁。

sentences.en: On January 26th the following year, he raped three women in a single day.
sentences.zh: 次年1月26日，他在一天之内强奸了三名女性。

sentences.en: The law eventually caught up with him after his fingerprints tied him to several crimes.
sentences.zh: 在指纹将他与多起犯罪联系起来后，法律最终制裁了他。

sentences.en: When Kunowski had his day in court, the prosecution sought the maximum penalty of 25 years' imprisonment, fearful that Kunowski's crimes would escalate if he was free.
sentences.zh: 当库诺夫斯基出庭受审时，检方担心如果他重获自由，罪行会进一步升级，因此寻求判处25年监禁的最高刑罚。

sentences.en: They noted that Kunowski was intelligent, stating,
sentences.zh: 他们指出库诺夫斯基很聪明，并称：

sentences.en: Intelligence is a common attribute of the psychopathic social offender.
sentences.zh: “高智商是精神病态社会罪犯的共同特征。”

sentences.en: Despite the prosecution's concerns,
sentences.zh: 尽管检方表达了担忧，

sentences.en: Andrei Kunowski was sentenced to just 15 years.
sentences.zh: 安德烈·库诺夫斯基最终仅被判处15年监禁。

sentences.en: Behind bars, Kunowski continued to offend by raping his cellmate.
sentences.zh: 在狱中，库诺夫斯基继续作恶，强奸了他的狱友。

sentences.en: At one point, he managed to escape custody and raped a 13-year-old girl while on the run.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他设法逃脱了监管，并在潜逃期间强奸了一名13岁女孩。

sentences.en: He was re-arrested the next day and returned to prison, only to escape again and commit a further six attacks.
sentences.zh: 他次日被重新逮捕并送回监狱，但没过多久又再次越狱，并又犯下了六起袭击案。

sentences.en: In 1983, he was caught and sentenced to 30 years, this time in a maximum security prison that managed to hold him.
sentences.zh: 1983年，他被抓获并被判处30年监禁，这次他被关进了一所能关住他的高度戒备监狱。

sentences.en: But then, in 1989,
sentences.zh: 但随后，在1989年，

sentences.en: Poland's first democratically elected president enacted an offender amnesty, wherein hundreds of prisoners were released for good behaviour.
sentences.zh: 波兰首位民选总统颁布了大赦令，数百名表现良好的囚犯因此获释。

sentences.en: Among them was Andrei Kunowski, who had only served six years of his three-decade sentence.
sentences.zh: 其中就包括安德烈·库诺夫斯基，他当时仅服刑了三十年刑期中的六年。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Kunowski began working as a salesman and commenced a relationship with a woman who gave birth to his child.
sentences.zh: 库诺夫斯基开始做推销员，并与一名女子建立了关系，对方还为他生下了一个孩子。

sentences.en: All the while, he continued attacking and raping girls and women.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他继续袭击并强奸女孩和女性。

sentences.en: Eventually, his partner learned of his extensive criminal history and promptly broke up with him.
sentences.zh: 最终，他的伴侣得知了他广泛的犯罪前科，随即与他分手。

sentences.en: Kunowski's crimes prompted the Polish press to dub him the Beast of Muawa.

sentences.en: In 1996, Kunowski followed a 10-year-old girl home from school and barged into her bedroom while she was home alone.
